hold.interpretation: Every observed hold must carry policy_missing and STALE_GENERATION at stage=lease with forwarding false. Signed lease generations resolve the ACK comparison; baseline alone is not a hold classification. Alarm is observed only when the original summary says true; 3 Steps or 30 seconds is diagnostic, never a forwarding grace. Missing Step events prevent independently reconstructing every unreported increment.
